game: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
key_point: Why Twilight Princess on Wii is backwards
title: Why Twilight Princess on Wii is backwards
caption: Nintendo mirrored the whole world of Twilight Princess on Wii so Link could be right-handed. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #zelda #twilightprincess

instagram.caption:
Link had always been left-handed. But on Wii, most players would swing the remote with their right hand.

Instead of just flipping Link, Nintendo mirrored the entire game. Every town, dungeon and map in the Wii version is flipped.

The GameCube version kept the original layout, so the same game exists in two mirror-image versions.

Did you play the Wii or GameCube version?
